title: Her Teenage Bedroom Was Rebuilt While She Was Out . . . (highlight)
caption:
In Love Next Door episode 2, Ethan secretly rebuilds Ruby's teenage bedroom, glow-in-the-dark stars and all. Full recap is on our page 👉 link in the comments

#lovenextdoor #kdrama #kdramarecap #spoilerroom #fyp

segments.say: Ruby opens her bedroom door and finds her teenage room rebuilt, down to the glow-in-the-dark *stars*.
To see how it got here, go back to the day Linda tells Ethan to redo Ruby's *room*.
Her daughter is not a piece of *luggage*, she says.
So Ethan measures the old storage room with a tablet, one *corner* at a time.
That evening, Ruby comes home to a family dinner, and her mom made *abalone* rice.
After dinner, she opens the door to her room, and her jaw *drops*.
Glow-in-the-dark stars cover the ceiling, exactly like when she was a *teenager*.
She calls Ethan in the middle of the night, and demands to know how he did *it*.
He rebuilt the desk where she wrote a love letter to her senior, and the bed where she *cried*.
Ruby nearly dies of embarrassment. Every cringe memory is *back*.
Then Ethan has one favor to ask. Close your *curtains*.
